title: Vibe coding a vertical slice
author: goat_face_vanilla
selftext:
Hey everyone 👋

Ive been mulling on a turn-based tactics + board game hybrid and finally kicked off the prompts 😄

I  plan to add quests, levelling, gear, and event effects that carry into the battles (like AP changes), but happy with the progress so far. All the text/sprites were made by the tool during generation and at some point Id like to go in and do a bit of HIL too.

Happy for feedback/suggestions if anyone has any!

[https://makermint.com/play/lich-crown?utm\_source=copy\_link&utm\_medium=clipboard&utm\_campaign=game\_share&utm\_content=lich-crown](https://makermint.com/play/lich-crown?utm_source=copy_link&utm_medium=clipboard&utm_campaign=game_share&utm_content=lich-crown)

comments.author: No-Thought-4864
comments.body: The sprites look decent for a first pass! Love that you’re planning for some HIL later; nothing like a bit of manual polish to give it that 'soul'... Quick question: are the quests going to be procedural too, or are you hand-crafting them?

replies.author: goat_face_vanilla
replies.body: I like to test things quickly so will probably start with generated text and go from there :)

comments.author: True_Audience_198
comments.body:
Honestly? This goes harder than it has any right to. You've got a full 4-person tactics party, fog of war overworld, a Lich Lord boss that summons skeletons mid-fight, and the writing is actually funny?? Bron complaining about slimes had me dying.   
  
BUT. My guy Shade is out here throwing smoke bombs that do literally nothing. Like the animation plays and everything but zero debuff. Pure vibes, zero function. Also there's no leveling so enemies just get harder while you stay the same strength forever.   
  
The optimal strategy is dying on purpose because it full heals you for free lmao. The Lich fight is genuinely tense though. Soul Drain below 50% HP is nasty design. Would 100% play a v2 with gear and actual working abilities. The foundation slaps, just needs the wiring finished.
